exempt.console: derived view over movies+tvshows; the console lists primary resources, not merged views
exempt.client: derived view over movies+tvshows; callers compose it client-side from mcu.movies/mcu.tvshows rather than a dedicated resource
exempt.snapshot: time-dependent (relative to 'today'); a static mirror snapshot would go stale immediately
exempt.mcp: read-only aggregate over movies+tvshows; the MCP server's read tools are search_content/get_stats/get_timeline, not per-endpoint mirrors

exempt.console: aggregate diagnostic endpoint, not a queryable resource; the landing page's hero tiles already surface it separately from the ENDPOINTS console
exempt.client: aggregate diagnostic endpoint; not a resource collection with list/get semantics
exempt.snapshot: time-dependent aggregate computed over the live dataset; would go stale immediately in a static mirror
